title: Organic Chemistry Basics
text: Organic chemistry is the study of carbon-containing compounds, which form the basis of all known life. Carbon's ability to form four stable bonds allows it to create long chains, rings, and complex branched structures. Major classes of organic compounds include hydrocarbons, alcohols, carboxylic acids, and proteins. Organic chemistry underlies the study of pharmaceuticals, plastics, fuels, and biochemistry.
